environment: Ubuntu 24.04 shared virtual runner; two installed IPVS/BIRD directors and nftables filters in namespaces
resource_scope: Per-unit cgroup snapshots are in the raw artifact. They exclude kernel IPVS/nftables dataplane CPU and total host cost.
